question_cn: a兵（或h兵）配上错色象（升变格颜色与象不同），黑王能守住角格，结果是：
question_en: Rook pawn (a or h) with wrong-colored bishop (bishop doesn't control promotion square color), Black king holds the corner:

options.text_cn: 白方必胜，只要王配合就行
和局，象无法将死守角的黑王
options.text_en: Draw — bishop cannot checkmate the king in the corner
Black king must leave the corner

explanation_cn: 这是象兵残局最重要的和局识别：错色象 + 边路兵 → 和局。升变格颜色 ≠ 象的颜色，守住角格的黑王永远不会被将死。学会识别这个模式能避免大量误判。
explanation_en: Most important draw pattern in bishop-pawn endgames: wrong-colored bishop + rook pawn = draw. The bishop can never checkmate the king sheltered in the promotion corner.
